about: Karsh-Naal Camp's people as world facts (person, household, person_note tables; tools/newworld/stockdb.py). Placement stays in newworld/places/tribal-camp-m2-m68/people.jsonl under the same ids. The tribeless Naga band sleeps in the longhouse as one household; they have no chief, so the one who counts the jars heads it. Jeeta-Sakka of quest 4 is cast on the night guard; Sesk and quest 4's three other Naga guards are the quest's to place.

people.name: Jeeta-Sakka
people.trade: the Unbound's hired warband, day watch at the longhouse fire; keeps the key to the cage

notes.text: He is the hired Naga who stands at the fire by the longhouse and carries the key to the cage at the camp's edge. He took the Unbound's coin first and talked the others into it.

people.name: Mazh-Teel
people.trade: the Unbound's hired warband, night watch

notes.text: She guards the jars by night for the Unbound's coin. She once took tolls on the road from Stormhold to Helstrom and misses the travellers more than the coin.

people.name: Hesseth
people.trade: stacks and counts the sap jars for the Unbound's crews

notes.text: She counts the jars the crews bring and the coin the Unbound leave, and the others let her speak for the camp though no one leads it. She keeps the tally in knots on a cord.

people.name: Ozhi-Rak
people.trade: carries sap jars between the crews and the longhouse

notes.text: He carries the crews' jars in from the marsh to the longhouse wall. He is Hesseth's partner and the strongest back in the camp.

people.name: Vuxalt
people.trade: keeps the bone shrine to Sithis

notes.text: He is the oldest of the camp and keeps the shrine of bones to Sithis. He says the jars bring nothing good and takes his share of the coin all the same.

people.name: Sileeth
people.trade: hunts the marsh for the camp's meat

notes.text: She hunts the marsh round the camp for meat and sets the best skulls at the foot of the bone totems. She watches the cage more often than the guards do.

people.name: Nakhoo
people.trade: fishes the creek and mends the hide tents

notes.text: He is the youngest of the band and fishes the creek below the camp. He joined for the coin and is quieter since the cage was filled.

people.name: Druuz
people.trade: poles the jars downriver to the cult's crews

notes.text: He poles a covered boat with the stacked jars from the creek bank to the place where the Unbound's crews collect them. He is paid by the trip and asks nothing of what the jars hold.
